### tungsten\_dewaele\_2004\_table1\_compression

- **Description:** All 42 Table I tungsten atomic-volume observations, with both printed ruby-pressure reductions.
- **Kind:** pressure\_volume
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Dewaele; Loubeyre; Mezouar
    - **Year:** 2004
    - **Source:** Phys. Rev. B
    - **Volume:** 70
    - **Locator:** 094112
    - **DOI:** 10.1103/PhysRevB.70.094112
- **Source location:** Table I, journal page 094112-4
- **Associated EOS records:** tungsten\_dewaele\_2004\_mao\_ruby\_vinet; tungsten\_dewaele\_2004\_vinet\_2; tungsten\_dewaele\_2019\_mao\_vinet; tungsten\_dewaele\_2019\_dor\_vinet
- **Notes:** Table I groups Cu/W/Al in the first two runs and Au/Pt/Ta in the last three runs. Blank metal cells are omitted rather than imputed. P\_R is the classical Mao et al. (1986) reduction (A=1904 GPa, B=7.665); P'\_R is the Dewaele et al. revision (A=1904 GPa, B=9.5). The paper states a common 0.01 angstrom^3/atom volume uncertainty and a pressure uncertainty increasing from 0.05 GPa at 1 GPa to 2 GPa at 150 GPa, but prints neither row-wise pressure errors nor raw R1 wavelengths.

[Observation resource](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/datasets/tungsten-dewaele-2004-table1-compression.csv)
— SHA-256 `d73f1d9114c974be80175c6ade256bf17cb4a529e911480e6cd1e337394ef523`.

### shen\_smith\_2026\_table\_s1\_simultaneous\_volumes

- **Description:** All 3,511 non-missing unit-cell volume measurements and standard errors from the two Supplemental Table S1 worksheets.
- **Kind:** simultaneous\_unit\_cell\_volumes
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Shen; Smith
    - **Year:** 2026
    - **Source:** Phys. Rev. B
    - **Volume:** 113
    - **Locator:** 144113
    - **DOI:** 10.1103/fxgq-96sg
- **Source location:** Supplemental Table S1 workbook, DAC-1 and DAC-2 worksheets
- **Associated EOS records:** tungsten\_shen\_2026\_vinet\_3
- **Notes:** The source workbook contains 228 numbered DAC-1 runs and 194 numbered DAC-2 runs. Each non-missing volume/error pair was normalized to one CSV row while retaining the experiment and run identifiers; blank and '--' cells were omitted, not inferred. Pt measurements bracketing each scan retain their source first/last sequence labels. Phase labels distinguish bcc-Fe from hcp-Fe and NaCl-B1 from NaCl-B2. The workbook defines the errors as standard errors combining peak-fitting standard deviations and dispersion among volumes from different (hkl) peaks. Cu reference volumes are included even though no separate Shen-Smith Cu EOS record is bundled. The complete workbook is retained rather than only the lower-scatter run subsets used for the preferred fits.

[Observation resource](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/datasets/shen-smith-2026-table-s1-volumes.csv)
— SHA-256 `1e8841829f67a7bdbcd654d3a4b87dcdbbaa81bc700b73e9c1800ae71d989f36`.
